questions.stem: Which idea for the hụi app is an example of "Substitute"?
options: Add flexible cycle lengths and a large-text mode
Replace typing amounts with a one-tap 'Paid' button
Borrow the due/overdue timeline from loan apps
Merge the ledger, reminders and a payment QR code
questions.answer: Replace typing amounts with a one-tap 'Paid' button
questions.explain: "Replace typing amounts with a one-tap 'Paid' button" applies Substitute.

questions.stem: Which idea for the hụi app is an example of "Combine"?
options: Show the player's view first instead of the host's
Remove sign-up and hand calculation of bid payouts
Reuse the ledger as a personal savings-goal tracker
Merge the ledger, reminders and a payment QR code
questions.answer: Merge the ledger, reminders and a payment QR code
questions.explain: "Merge the ledger, reminders and a payment QR code" applies Combine.

questions.stem: Which idea for the hụi app is an example of "Adapt"?
options: Replace typing amounts with a one-tap 'Paid' button
Show the player's view first instead of the host's
Borrow the due/overdue timeline from loan apps
Add flexible cycle lengths and a large-text mode
questions.answer: Borrow the due/overdue timeline from loan apps
questions.explain: "Borrow the due/overdue timeline from loan apps" applies Adapt.

questions.stem: Which idea for the hụi app is an example of "Modify"?
options: Remove sign-up and hand calculation of bid payouts
Reuse the ledger as a personal savings-goal tracker
Replace typing amounts with a one-tap 'Paid' button
Add flexible cycle lengths and a large-text mode
questions.answer: Add flexible cycle lengths and a large-text mode
questions.explain: "Add flexible cycle lengths and a large-text mode" applies Modify.

questions.stem: Which idea for the hụi app is an example of "Put to another use"?
options: Borrow the due/overdue timeline from loan apps
Add flexible cycle lengths and a large-text mode
Reuse the ledger as a personal savings-goal tracker
Remove sign-up and hand calculation of bid payouts
questions.answer: Reuse the ledger as a personal savings-goal tracker
questions.explain: "Reuse the ledger as a personal savings-goal tracker" applies Put to another use.

questions.stem: Which idea for the hụi app is an example of "Eliminate"?
options: Show the player's view first instead of the host's
Add flexible cycle lengths and a large-text mode
Remove sign-up and hand calculation of bid payouts
Reuse the ledger as a personal savings-goal tracker
questions.answer: Remove sign-up and hand calculation of bid payouts
questions.explain: "Remove sign-up and hand calculation of bid payouts" applies Eliminate.

questions.stem: Which idea for the hụi app is an example of "Rearrange/Reverse"?
options: Borrow the due/overdue timeline from loan apps
Show the player's view first instead of the host's
Add flexible cycle lengths and a large-text mode
Replace typing amounts with a one-tap 'Paid' button
questions.answer: Show the player's view first instead of the host's
questions.explain: "Show the player's view first instead of the host's" applies Rearrange/Reverse.

questions.stem: Which SCAMPER technique is this? The team swaps the paper notebook for a phone ledger.
questions.explain: This is Substitute.

questions.stem: Which SCAMPER technique is this? A backpack gets a built-in charger, so two products become one.
questions.explain: This is Combine.

questions.stem: Which SCAMPER technique is this? Designers copy how chat apps share a picture so receipts can go to a group.
questions.explain: This is Adapt.

questions.stem: Which SCAMPER technique is this? Text size, button size and cycle length all become adjustable.
questions.explain: This is Modify.

questions.stem: Which SCAMPER technique is this? A ledger built for hụi is also used to track a personal savings goal.
questions.explain: This is Put to another use.

questions.stem: Which SCAMPER technique is this? The app no longer asks users to create an account.
questions.explain: This is Eliminate.

questions.stem: Which SCAMPER technique is this? The home screen shows what a player owes this week, not the host's list.
questions.explain: This is Rearrange/Reverse.

questions.stem: Which of these is NOT one of the seven SCAMPER techniques?
questions.explain: SCAMPER = Substitute, Combine, Adapt, Modify, Put to another use, Eliminate, Rearrange/Reverse.

questions.stem: What does the letter P in SCAMPER stand for?
questions.explain: P asks: who else could use this product, or where else could it be used?

questions.stem: Dead hụi (no interest): 10 members each pay 2,000,000 VND per cycle. In simplified form the receiver does not pay in their own cycle. How much VND does the receiver collect?

Live hụi (with interest): 10 members, base contribution 1,000,000 VND. In cycle 3 the winner bids a discount of 200,000 VND. Members who already collected pay in full; members still waiting pay base minus the bid; the winner pays nothing. How much VND does the winner collect?
questions.hint: Two members collected in cycles 1 and 2; seven are still waiting.

questions.stem: The app records these actual payments (VND): 2,000,000; 2,000,000; 1,800,000; 2,000,000; 2,000,000; 1,500,000. The plan is 10 cycles x 2,000,000. How much VND remains to be paid?
questions.hint: Remaining = planned total - total actually paid.

questions.stem: 7 of 12 cycles are marked as paid. What is the progress percentage, rounded to the nearest whole number?
